name: SEKA ExAero / ExAero RDC
why_interesting: A purpose-built aero road platform with current official RDC and Standard frame-weight claims and broad cockpit sizing; a matched complete owner-build weight remains unverified.
missing: Exact mainland package and price mapping for standard versus RDC
Current mainland checkout, delivery and warranty handling for each trim
Current exact RDC or Standard frameset price and checkout mapping
Eligible public owner-build weight with exact trim, size, components, scale reading and included accessories

facts.frame: T1100/M46J-claimed carbon with one-piece molding, fully internal routing and UDH
facts.frame_weight_basis: RDC size 54 bare frame 820 g; Standard size 54 bare frame 935 g; each ±35 g, excluding paint and metal parts (current China page).
facts.sizes: 44, 49, 52, 54, 56, 58 and 61; official chainstays are 408 mm across the range
facts.drivetrain: Shimano Di2 and SRAM AXS routing documented; removable front-derailleur mount
facts.cockpit: Gladius standard or ALTA +25 mm, each offered in 19 combinations; MAG aero bottles are sold separately
facts.stiffness_evidence: Manufacturer comparative structural claims reproduced by a current specialist retailer: versus SEKA Spear, front lateral stiffness +21.2%, rear lateral stiffness +7.6%, and overall torsional stiffness +13.4% (367 to 416). Test protocol and units are undisclosed; not independent lab evidence.
facts.model_identity: Current SEKA China road page distinguishes ExAero RDC and Standard; ExAero GR is a separate product. No road-generation code is stated.

price_status: Unresolved: the current official China page shows no frameset price; the dated ¥11,900起 launch post describes complete-system prices by cockpit, not an exact RDC or Standard frameset checkout. A distinct secondary launch article surfaced Standard starting-price and RDC maximum-price references, but its page timed out and its indexed figures do not identify a selected package or current checkout.
source_note: Current China manufacturer page confirms distinct RDC and Standard road frames, 54-size bare-frame weights (820 g RDC and 935 g Standard, ±35 g, excluding paint and metal parts) and 32 mm nominal clearance. The page links its official Taobao store but shows no price; the linked store failed to open. The 2026-08-14 ¥11,900起 public headline is not assignable to an exact frameset because the post describes its table as complete-system retail by cockpit configuration. A separate secondary launch article surfaced indexed Standard starting-price and RDC maximum-price references, but the page timed out and no selected-package or current-checkout price could be verified. No eligible public non-XHS owner build with exact trim, components and weighing basis was found; the prior 6.67 kg lead is not promoted as a normalized build weight.

enrichment_reviews.scope: Exact current source additions; existing observations, conflicts and collection dates retained.

resolved_missing_history.note: Original missing clause retained verbatim; exact product-linked seven-size chart is transcribed, with original URL/hash retained in the added source.
